notes.title: Minor error reporting improvements
notes.notes:
- Modified the client to automatically alert the developers if there are issues connecting to the webserver.
- Also automatically reports crashes within the app.

notes.title: Fix 'Game Starting' Popup
notes.notes: The Game Starting popup would often stay around too long.

notes.title: Added Achievements Page
notes.notes: Added an achievements page. There are achievements for getting to different waves with groups of different sizes (solo, a party of 2-4 players, or a "rave" of 5+ players).

notes.title: Mac build update
notes.notes: Updated the Mac build for the recent webserver certificate changes.

notes.title: Quick windows fix
notes.notes: Uploaded an old windows build in the last update. Fixed

notes.title: Fix for webserver connection issues
notes.notes: Some players have problems connecting to the webserver when the game starts up. This should fix the issue. If you still have trouble connecting, please reach out by Discord and we'll get it fixed.

notes.title: Two New Vermin and Graphics Improvements
notes.notes:
- Added two new vermin types, the flea vermin and mole-turret vermin. They start spawning in around Wave 3.
- Slightly improved death animation.
- Left to do: I have been working on improving the graphics and juicing up the gameplay interactions.  This update has some work-in-progress changes to the vermin death animation, but there is more to come.

notes.title: Adding Demo
notes.notes: Made some changes to support adding a Steam Demo. The demo should be coming soon.

notes.title: Networking Improvements
notes.notes:
- The app now reports automatically to the developer when you cannot connect to the webserver. Hopefully this such let me track down any issues where people cannot connect.
- Fixed up the UI so that you can still Play Solo and Play Tutorial even if the webserver connection is disconnected.
- Now that these couple error-reporting updates are done, I'm hoping to add a couple more enemy types by the end of the week.

notes.title: Possible Fix for Crash on Start Issue
notes.notes: I have been tracking down the crash that some users get when they try to start any game. I may have fixed it, but I'm still investigating. I suspect the problem was due to using some very large textures for the game map. This update breaks the map into several smaller textures.

notes.title: Error Reporting Improvements
notes.notes: Added improved error reporting. I'm still tracking down the crashes players are experiencing immediately on trying to start the game, sorry for the delay here.
